backdatedEmails.subject: My pledge for the raffle basket
backdatedEmails.body: Hi! Count me in for the Spring Fair raffle. I'd like to pledge $20 toward the prize basket, and I can drop the cash off on your porch Friday afternoon. So glad you're running this again. - Marjorie

backdatedEmails.subject: Raffle basket pledge
backdatedEmails.body: Happy to help the fair along! Pledging $12 for the prize basket fund. Let me know if you need volunteers at the ticket table on the day too. - Desmond
